newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to overhaul financial taxes.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to overhaul financial taxes.

text.p: The Philippine finance department is considering overhauling the taxes imposed on instruments and products in the financial markets, finance undersecretary Milwida Guevara said on Monday.

Guevara said the planned tax restructuring might include repeal of the documentary stamp tax for all financial instruments and other double taxation schemes imposed on reverse repurchases, insurance policies and mutual funds in order to help develop the markets.
The presidential task force on tax and tariff reforms hopes to draft the new tax bills by January and submit them to Congress for decision, Guevara told reporters.
"There have been so many developments in the country's financial markets which call for an overhauling of some aspects of our taxation blueprint," she said.

The task force, which includes academics and businessmen, was set up three years ago to draft a comprehensive tax reform package aimed at restructuring the excise tax on beer and cigarettes, the oil tax and corporate and individual income taxes.
